<document id=DOC_req_years_nine>
Required: 9 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_eight_plus>
Backend engineering: 8+ years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Report the match as it actually is. Where the summary cannot establish the
requirement, say so rather than assuming either way.

response.text:
- Requirement (from DOC_req_years_nine): 9 years of backend engineering experience required.
- Candidate summary (from DOC_summary_states_eight_plus): 8+ years of backend engineering experience.

Assessment:
The candidate summary states "8+ years" of experience, which does not explicitly meet the requirement of "9 years." The summary cannot establish that the candidate has at least 9 years of backend engineering experience as required.

Conclusion:
The candidate does not meet the requirement based on the information provided. The match cannot be established.
